# 0133. The old panel (graphView.js and the pages' HTML in tasksView, docsView, exerciseView) is deleted;…

## Context and Problem Statement

Task #202: ui(cleanup): move Exercises, Meetings, Social and the change graph into the new panel, then delete the old panel.

## Considered Options

User, 2026-11-10: none of the old panel's last features move over (answering records in the panel, the 30-day stats, New task, the full call timeline with turn ticks); go on with the new design. What outlives the panel moves out of it: the waiting count and its upkeep to vscode/inbox.js; every command that opened the old panel opens the new one at the matching area; the new panel re-renders when the database changes. The pure models other modules use (renderMarkdown, meetingsModel, exerciseModel, inboxCount, slugify…) stay where they are. Considered: keeping the old panel behind a setting; rejected, two UIs to keep in step.

## Decision Outcome

The old panel (graphView.js and the pages' HTML in tasksView, docsView, exerciseView) is deleted; the new panel is the only one
